thread:
sana (Revenue): Heads-up: discovered an EUR vendor invoice from SkyGrid (INV-EU-991) that posted in March after we ran close. Invoice total €52,000 (~$56,480 @ close rate) should be treated as prepaid hosting (12-month amort). It was unintentionally booked as an expense/contra-revenue due to mapping + FX pipeline ordering. Need guidance on reclassification + FX reval. cc diego, marta

fx-bot: New vendor invoice detected: INV-EU-991 (SkyGrid). Amount: EUR 52,000. Received 2026-03-30 17:04 CET. FX rate at posting (2026-03-30) 1.0865 USD/EUR.

diego (Billing): The billing feed set type=vendor_promo which our pipeline maps to contra-revenue. For SkyGrid-hosted commits we expect type=vendor_prepay. Also the invoice landed after close so GL has a contra-revenue of $4,120 recorded on 3/31.

marta (Controller): Because it posted after the published close pack we need a post-close adjusting JE plus an FX revaluation if we record deferred balance at USD. What's the USD amount you want posted to deferred? Use the rate at invoice receipt or month-end reval?

sana (Revenue): Recommendation: reverse the contra-revenue posted (use original USD posting amount $4,120), then create deferred revenue at USD using invoice-day FX rate for the full EUR 52k -> $56,498 (rounded). Amortize over 12 months. Any difference from initial contra-revenue reversal goes to an FX variance account.

diego (Billing): Proposed JEs:

"Post-Close Adjusting Entries - March 2026"
Journal 1 (reverse wrong posting):
Dr Contra-Revenue 4,120
Cr Accounts Payable / Cash 4,120
Memo: Reverse auto-applied contra-rev for INV-EU-991 mis-map

Journal 2 (establish deferred at invoice-day FX):
Dr Accounts Payable 56,498
Cr Deferred Revenue 56,498
Memo: Record deferred (EUR 52k @ 1.0865) for SkyGrid INV-EU-991

Journal 3 (FX variance tidy):
Dr FX Loss / Cr FX Gain (plug) ~?
Memo: Capture FX difference between initial USD posting and invoice-day conversion

marta (Controller): For audit I'll need: invoice PDF, billing event export, FX rate source (Bloomberg/GTreasury feed snapshot), and sign-off from Billing and Revenue. Also need legal contract confirming 12-month term.

sana (Revenue): Uploaded docs: https://files.redwood/INV-EU-991.pdf, billing export: https://files.redwood/billing/export-eu-991.csv, contract: CR-4789 confirming 12-month prepay. FX snapshot: https://finance.redwood/fx/2026-03-30-feed.csv (rate 1.0865).

diego (Billing): I'll create WP: WP-INV-EU-991 and open mapping PR to stop vendor_promo mapping for vendor=SkyGrid SKUs matching "hosted-commit". PR link will be attached.

ian (Head of Finance): I'm comfortable with the approach. Marta, please approve the adjusting JEs once backups are attached. Also add a control item to validate FX source and conversion policy for post-close vendor invoices.

marta (Controller): Approve contingent on docs. Once posted I'll update the deferred revenue schedule and show the FX variance line in the month reconciliations. Will route to accounting@redwood.com for posting.

sana (Revenue): Thanks all — I'll monitor mapping PR and run a 90-day search for other EUR vendor invoices that may have been mis-tagged.

diego (Billing): Quick scan returned INV-EU-976 and INV-EU-980 both OK. Only 991 was mis-tagged in the draft run. Will attach results to the workpaper.

sana (Revenue): Great. Closing loop: post JE, update schedule, add control to quarter plan.
